provenance: Previously saved K1 module configuration export; not read live in the 2026-11-06 support audit.
deployment_notes: Continuous raw audio dumping was disabled with common.debug=0 in the prior module repair.
Gains and beam values are historical references for this hardware, not settings to overwrite on every module.
Host ALSA speaker volume and prompt loudness are separate from these module settings.
Wake keyword and threshold are managed by the existing host serial protocol when configured.
Manufacturer firmware, wake resource and licensed engine are not included in this reference.
